decisions.reason: Changing the enclosure's primary color to beige does not change the existing DJ turntable-inspired visual theme.
The bowl-size clause in the same message is already represented by a separate MODIFY; the beige color decision does not affect bowl capacity or form.
Enclosure color does not change the enclosure's size, side profile, or accommodation of deep bowl wells.
The color selection does not alter the required splash-control behavior.
The beige enclosure color has no entailed effect on valve dripping, spout sealing, or bowl leak prevention.
The color decision does not change the spout's location, orientation, or pouring goal.
Enclosure color does not affect the base-stability or vibration-resistance requirement.
The source selects a design color but does not change the requirement to deliver a prototype bill of materials.
The beige color selection does not change the required system-layout deliverable or its scope.
The enclosure color decision has no effect on the electrical wiring-plan deliverable.
The primary color selection does not alter the required mixing quality or foam consistency.
The beige design color does not affect the 120V power source, battery exclusion, or power-architecture priority.
